left.raw_text: Psychotic depression by DSM-IV, i.e., presence of delusions with a SCID-R score higher than 2
High suicide risk, i.e. intent or plan to attempt suicide in near future
Presence of any Axis I psychiatric disorder (other than unipolar major depression) or substance abuse
History of psychiatric disorders other than unipolar major depression or generalized anxiety disorder (bipolar disorder, hypomania, and dysthemia are exclusion criteria)
